title: StillHere
creator: Godson-droid
summary: MIT-licensed dead-man’s-switch vault with an owner badge, beneficiary, epoch deadline and walletless simulation. The badge holder can check in, withdraw, change the beneficiary or close the vault; after the deadline anyone may trigger payment directly to the beneficiary. A late check-in before release revives the vault. November 20, 2026: the official Esmeralda indexer records the submitted template publication as committed on November 19, network byte 38. The browser is a simulation, not a wallet interface. The README reports 55 engine tests; these were not rerun. Review used the original forum post, full README, MIT license, public page text and available deployment metadata. No third-party code was installed or executed, and no wallet or transaction was operated. The recording is a continuous README walkthrough with page scripts and downloads disabled.
cardSummary: Explore heartbeat check-ins and beneficiary releases through an Esmeralda vault template and walletless browser simulation.
